title: Native VIXEN build helper needs heartbeat output
body: The queued build command bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent brickcost --resource build --label brickcost:baseline-native-build --credits 4 -- bash reports/brickcost/reproduce/native-build.sh was stopped at 229 seconds after 180 seconds without output, although the native status file still showed 475 of 544 targets complete and zero failures. The native PowerShell wrapper updates its status file but emits no progress until completion. I added a 60-second heartbeat with an exit trap. Consolidate periodic progress output into the shared native runner so active builds keep their queue slot.

title: Native MSVC preset must handle generated C4457 warnings
body: The queued native vixen_lookdev_capture build failed in SVO/src/BulkMaterialization.cpp because generated RecipeSimd.g.hpp emits C4457 and project /WX promotes it to an error. I added /wd4457 to this lane's native CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS so the required capture target can build. Consolidate the MSVC generated-code warning policy into the shared VIXEN native preset.

title: Native MSVC preset must enable extended aligned storage
body: The queued native vixen_lookdev_capture build failed while compiling BodyOctreeSceneNode.cpp: MSVC C2338 says std::aligned_storage<144,16> requires _ENABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE on the active toolchain. I added /D_ENABLE_EXTENDED_ALIGNED_STORAGE to this lane's native CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS. Consolidate the toolchain compatibility define into the shared VIXEN native preset.

title: Native measurement preset overrides must preserve Windows compiler defaults
body: CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS replaced CMake's normal Windows flags and caused C4530 in the SVO precompiled header. I recovered by explicitly carrying /DWIN32 /D_WINDOWS /GR /EHsc forward with the two compatibility flags. Consolidate this merge behavior into the shared native preset.

title: Native capture wrapper should expose ExtraEnv clearly
body: Passing a fourth positional argument to run-captures.sh bound it to capture-matrix.ps1's Root parameter, so the harness looked for configs under C:\VIXEN_WINDOW_WIDTH=1920. The run succeeds when ExtraEnv is passed explicitly as -ExtraEnv plus the settings string. Make the shared wrapper expose this parameter directly.
